blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The intertropical convergence zone (ITCZ) and northeasterly wind flow will bring rains in parts of the country on Wednesday, according to the state weather bureau. In the 5 a.m. weather forecast of the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa), weather specialist Chenel Dominguez said that the ITCZ, or the convergence of winds from the northern and southern hemispheres, will affect Palawan, Visayas, and Mindanao. On the other hand, northeasterly windflow will prevail over the Extreme Northern Luzon.
